audit.whatIsWrong: Every phases[N].side read 'Yone' while the content layer and the packet both read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei.
audit.why: Mortal Steel reaches 450 and Spirit Cleave 700, both inside every paint Hwei owns, and the matchup runs 51.96% over 3801 games.
audit.corrected: Full layer moved onto the content chart: Hwei 1-3, Skill at 4-5 and 6, Hwei at first item and two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[3].text was corrupt — it read 'Your R (Spiral Fate style ults are Yone's job, not yours) — actually your Deathbook Vortex / R ultimate...', naming two abilities that do not exist. spikes[1].text invented 'Grim Portrait stacks'.
audit.why: Hwei's ultimate is Spiraling Despair; there is no Deathbook Vortex, no Spiral Fate and no Grim Portrait. Yone's ultimate is Fate Sealed.
audit.corrected: Late spike rewritten around Spiraling Despair's 1300 range against Fate Sealed's 1000, and the level 6 spike around Soul Unbound's 22s rank-1 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly told you Yone has a wind wall — 'windwall can block a key Hwei spell' in whys[3], 'his windwall can eat one of your spells but not both if you sequence W before Q' in mid, and 'Windwall your key spell to open a trade' in wants.foe[0]. Yone has no wind wall.
audit.why: Yone's kit is Way of the Hunter, Mortal Steel, Spirit Cleave, Soul Unbound, Fate Sealed. Wind Wall belongs to Yasuo. What actually absorbs your paint is Spirit Cleave's shield, on 14s, scaling with the number of champions hit.
audit.corrected: Every wind wall reference replaced with the real absorber (Spirit Cleave's shield) and the real escape clock (Soul Unbound, 22s at rank 1, which forces him back to his body when it ends).

audit.why: Soul Unbound is 22/19/16/13/10s, Spirit Cleave a flat 14s that shortens with attack speed, Mortal Steel 4s.
